messages:
maya: Alert: sudden increase in 502/503s for acme-org in eu-west after the midnight policy rollout. Dash shows per-org burst budget collapsed from ~1k -> 10. https://dash.example.com/orgs/acme-org

sam: I rolled a tight burst policy for our test orgs last night (00:05 UTC). I did a global apply script but I thought I filtered by tag. investigating whether acme-org got hit.

lena: seeing matching audit event: opsbot says policy-change actor=sam, policy_id=policy-87, target=org:acme-org, old_burst=1000, new_burst=10

ryan: That explains it. Runtime started enforcing new policy immediately; routing layer still had cached per-key quotas that expected higher burst -> mismatch led to enforcement errors and 503s when fallback paths overflowed.

sam: confirmed — my script used a tag that matched both test-* and acme-* (oops). I'm prepping a rollback now.

maya: pls revert and invalidate caches. can you run the rollback and then run cache invalidate for acme-org?

sam: rollback executed:

```
$ adminctl policy rollback policy-87 --to-revision=rev-2026-03-15
Rollback successful: policy-87 -> rev-2026-03-15
```

then invalidating caches: `/admin/cache/invalidate --org acme-org`

opsbot: cache-invalidate job queued id=inv-992, started=1768921304

lena: routing cache returned TTL mismatch on first attempt; second invalidate succeeded. enforcement metrics dropping back to normal.

ryan: Can we get a small log snippet of the 502s? here's one showing runtime hitting enforcement with mismatched policy id:

```
[2026-03-15T00:13:12Z] request_id=abc123 org=acme-org key=sk-prod-xyz enforcement=per_org_burst applied_policy=policy-87 runtime_policy=policy-78 result=deny status=502
```

maya: timeline looks like: 00:05 policy applied (bad tag), 00:12 runtime enforcement turned strict -> client errors spike, 00:15 rollback + cache invalidate, 00:20 errors subside.

sam: root cause: my global apply script had an incorrect tag filter. mitigation: adding a safety check in the script and a dry-run that lists affected org ids before apply. also will add a manual confirmation gate for >50 org targets.

ryan: Ops follow-up: (1) automatic cross-check that control-plane policy change and runtime observed policy id match within 60s for any per-org policy change; (2) console UI should highlight when a policy apply affects >5 non-test orgs.

oncall-bot: Incident P2 opened 1768921100 by maya. Affected: acme-org (production). Mitigation: rollback & cache invalidate. Monitoring: green at 1768922457.

maya: thanks all. little postmortem to write but incident is resolved. assigning action items to sam/ryan/lena. :thumbsup:

sam: sorry folks, will own the postmortem and the script fixes.

lena: adding follow-up tickets in backlog (policy-guard, runtime-policy-check).

ryan: closing channel once postmortem is in.

maya: closing thread — mark as resolved.
